# Creafex Lab

Creafex Lab is Vladimir Haltakov's independent product company.

## Products

- [Simple Photo Gallery](https://simple.photo/) — Turn a collection of photos into a story-driven gallery that is easy to share.
- [SimplePost](https://simplepost.social/) — Draft, schedule, and publish social posts from AI assistants.
- [Simple Muscle](https://simplemuscle.ai/) — A focused iPhone workout tracker that connects training data to AI assistants.
- [Simple Unmark](https://simpleunmark.com/) — Remove hidden artifacts and reduce statistical watermark patterns in AI text.
- [Leoline](https://leoline.fun/) — A voice-first storyteller that creates age-appropriate adventures for children.

## Founder

- [Vladimir Haltakov](https://haltakov.com/)
